seo.title: Steps AI vs Chatbase: an honest comparison | Steps AI
seo.description: Compare Steps AI and Chatbase: channels, order lookups, pricing model and where each one is the better fit.

hero.title: Steps AI vs Chatbase: reading pages or checking records.
hero.body: Chatbase builds an AI chatbot from your website and documents. Steps AI does that too, then goes further: it checks real orders, books appointments and works on WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger.
hero.reassurance: Where we fit. Where they fit. How to switch.

glance.title: At a glance.
glance.intro: How Steps AI and Chatbase compare on the questions owners ask most.

rows.label: What it is
rows.steps: An AI agent that answers customers and checks real records before it replies
rows.them: An AI chatbot trained on your website and documents

rows.label: Channels
rows.steps: Website, WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger from one Meta connection, plus phone calls
rows.them: Website, with messaging channels through integrations

rows.label: Order and delivery questions
rows.steps: Checks orders in Shopify or WooCommerce and shipments with five Indian carriers
rows.them: Answers from the content it was trained on

rows.label: How you pay
rows.steps: Per reply in credits. The cost of a reply depends on the AI model you choose
rows.them: Credit-based plans. Removing branding is a paid add-on

rows.label: What happens after the answer
rows.steps: Books appointments, creates tickets, saves leads and hands over to a person
rows.them: Answers questions, with actions available through integrations

ours.title: When Steps AI is the better fit.
ours.intro: Choose Steps AI if these sound like you.

items.title: Customers ask where their order is
items.body: Steps AI checks the order in Shopify or WooCommerce instead of reciting your shipping policy.

items.title: You want the agent to look like your brand
items.body: Add your own logo and colours to the chat widget and your agent page.

items.title: You need WhatsApp and Instagram
items.body: One Meta connection covers WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger.

theirs.title: When Chatbase may suit you better.
theirs.intro: We would rather you pick the right tool than the wrong one.

items.title: You want a developer-led chatbot
items.body: If your team wants to build its own chatbot experience with an API first, Chatbase is set up for that.

items.title: Your use is mostly document Q&A
items.body: For answering from documents on a website alone, both products can do the job.

switching.title: Moving from Chatbase to Steps AI.
switching.intro: Most businesses are answering real customers within a day.

items.title: Paste your website address
items.body: Steps AI reads your pages, FAQs and documents, so you do not have to rebuild your answers by hand.

items.title: Connect your channels and store
items.body: One Meta connection covers WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger. Add Shopify or WooCommerce for order questions.

items.title: Test it against your own questions
items.body: Ask the questions your customers ask. Switch it on when you are happy with the answers.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: This comparison uses publicly available information about Chatbase as of October 2026. Check their site for current plans and features.
Steps AI does not answer inbound email, and AI voice calls are billed as credits.

faq.title: Questions about Steps AI and Chatbase.

items.q: Can I try Steps AI before I switch?
items.a: Yes. You can start free with no card, test the agent against your own questions and switch when you are ready.
You pay per reply in credits. The number of credits a reply uses depends on the AI model you choose for your agent.

items.q: Can I run Steps AI alongside Chatbase?
items.a: Yes, many businesses test both before deciding. Make sure only one tool replies on each channel at a time.
